name: reward-bench-chat-original
description: A dataset of chat response comparisons intended for training and evaluating reward models / preference models for conversational agents. It contains human preference labels (pairwise comparisons) over candidate responses to prompts, enabling assessment of how well a model's reward predictions align with human judgments.
reputation: A practical dataset for reward-model and RLHF research with modest adoption among researchers working on preference modeling and chat alignment.
